flyer.justification: The flyer is well-structured, adheres strictly to word count and TBA constraints, and captures key themes accurately.

instagram.justification: Follows all formatting rules including visual cues and targeted hashtags, though it includes an external web URL not found in the transcript.

linkedin.justification: Well-written post avoiding banned cliches/fillers, but fails the format requirement to include 3-5 hashtags.

summary.justification: Excellent executive summary under 400 words adhering strictly to all structure and markdown requirements.

newsletter.justification: Adheres to all format requirements, including subject line character limit and editorial three-section layout.

blog.justification: Comprehensive, highly readable blog post that fulfills all structure requirements including table, numbered sections, and author bio.
